about_the_game:
Figure Shop Simulator Demo offers a limited experience where you can start building and managing your own figure shop. Don’t forget to add the full game to your wishlist to keep the fun going!

To grow your business, efficiently manage your storage, expand your store, and customize its design. Create rare figures for collectors, follow trends, and increase your profits by stocking the most in-demand figures.

But be careful! Stock management, customer satisfaction, and pricing are crucial to your business's success. Can you make the right strategic decisions to take your shop to the top of the industry?

Key Features:

  • 3D figure production and customization

  • Shelf management, pricing, and customer satisfaction

  • Create collection sets and discover rare figures

  • Follow market trends and identify best-selling products

  • Build your shop from the ground up and become the biggest name in the figure collecting world!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 3550 / RYZEN 5 2500X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD R9 270X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Run your own figure shop! Produce figures with 3D printers, stock your shelves, set prices, and offer the best shopping experience to your customers. Manage your storage, expand and design your store. Try to complete collection sets, follow market trends, and grow your business!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish, Ukrainian, Hindi
